_provenance: Copied from the PAS repository (patient-administration-system, spec/openapi.json) at commit b64b7e2, 2026-11-10, for the EPR's contract test (RS-5). The PAS owns these; a copy drifts, so refresh it from the PAS when its interface changes.

Amendment.description: A correction to an open suspicion (FR-224). Each field left out is kept; at least one must change.

reason.description: Why it is being corrected. Kept in the audit.

subtype.description: A code from the condition's list in the profile it was recorded under.

subtype_scheme.description: When given, must be that list's scheme.

NewSuspicion.description: What a person records: the condition, the point of suspicion and who suspected it.

condition.description: A condition code of the active profile (`GET /api/suspicion-profile`).

subtype.description: A code from the condition's subtype list, if it has one; refused if it has none.

subtype_scheme.description:
The list the sender took `subtype` from. When given, it must be the active profile's list for the
condition, so a code from another list is refused rather than relabelled (FR-223).

StopReason.description: Why a suspicion's clock stopped. Any one stops it, and only one is recorded.

stopped_on.description: The date the clock stopped: the treatment start, the downgrade, or the death.
